NinjaTrader Guide, Prop Firm Accounts

Assigning Algos and Strategies to Your Prop Firm Account

This walks you through reconnecting your algos in NinjaTrader after an updater and assigning them to your prop firm account, then clearing out the old strategies once the new ones are running.

If you wish to see the walkthrough video, you can watch it here. Otherwise, the steps below have you covered. Your progress is saved on this device.

0 of 6 steps complete

Tick each step as you go.

  1. 1

    Log into NinjaTrader

    A minute or two

    Your strategies reconnect to your prop firm account through NinjaTrader, so it needs to be fully loaded before you start reassigning anything.

    1. Double click the red icon for NinjaTrader to get it going.
    2. Log into your NinjaTrader.
    3. Wait until NinjaTrader is fully loaded before moving to the next step.
    Walkthrough 0:02 to 0:16
  2. 2

    Open the strategies list on the chart

    A minute

    This opens the list of strategies available to load onto that chart. This walkthrough uses B2X as the example, but the same steps apply to any algo you are reassigning.

    1. Locate the chart for the algo you want to reassign.
    2. Click off of the candles first. Clicking directly on a candle drops a marker dot on the chart, so click into a blank area off to the side instead.
    3. Right click in that blank area and go to Strategies.
    4. Your strategies load into the list on the left under Available.
    Walkthrough 0:16 to 0:48
  3. 3

    Find your algo and load its template

    A minute per algo

    The PF and non-PF versions of an algo sit in different spots on the list, so it is easy to grab the wrong one. Loading the same template version across all of your algos keeps them on a consistent baseline.

    1. In the Available list, the versions without _PF in the title sit up top and the versions with _PF in the title sit further down. On a prop firm account, always pick the _PF version for every algo that has one. The full list is below.
    2. Double click your algo. It drops down into Configured.
    3. With it selected, go to Templates, then Load.
    4. Choose the same template version for all of your algos. Match your period-zero, period-one, and period-two strategies to their matching template version so everything cycles together.
    The prop firm (_PF) versions to load. Seven algos have a dedicated prop firm build. On a prop firm account, load the strategy that has _PF in its name:
    • ARPD (MGC) → ARPD_PF
    • DJDR (YM) → DJDR_PF
    • IFSP (NG) → IFSP_PF
    • OGX (MNQ) → OGX_PF
    • PLPI (PL) → PLPI_PF
    • RBO (M2K) → RBO_PF
    • SYFY (MES) → SYFY_PF
    Any algo that does not have a _PF version uses its standard version on a prop firm account.
    Walkthrough 0:48 to 1:36
  4. 4

    Select your prop firm account and apply

    A minute

    This is what actually turns the algo on for your prop firm account. The Account field is not always at the top of the panel for every strategy, so scroll down and check if you do not see it right away.

    1. Scroll down in the Properties panel if the Account field is not visible near the top.
    2. Select the account field, then choose your prop firm account.
    3. Click Apply, then OK.
    4. Confirm the strategy shows up in your Strategies tab with your account attached.
    Reassign every strategy you want running any time there is an updater or you want to move onto a new set of algos.
    Walkthrough 1:36 to 1:52
  5. 5

    Repeat for the next algo

    A few minutes

    Each algo gets reassigned on its own chart, so you are not finished after the first one. Each algos tab gets matched up with its corresponding chart, one at a time, until it is completed for your arrangement.

    1. Start this process over from section 2, Open the strategies list on the chart.
    2. Find the next algos tab and its corresponding chart.
    3. Run sections 2 through 4 again for that algo.
    4. Keep matching each algos tab to its corresponding chart until it is completed for your arrangement.
  6. 6

    Remove the old strategies

    A minute

    Once the new strategies are reassigned and confirmed, the old ones from before the updater are just clutter and should come out so your Strategies tab only shows what's actually running.

    1. Select the old strategy or strategies you want out. This is one of the few places you can select more than one at a time.
    2. Right click and choose Remove.
    Walkthrough 2:02 to 2:10

  7. Strategies reassigned

    Your algos are reconnected and assigned to your prop firm account on a matching template version, with the old pre-updater strategies removed. If anything looks off, post in your Discord channel.
